name: whiff
description: Local Rocket League stats tracker built on the game's Stats API

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n collector,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @rl/collector" "npm run dev -w @rl/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w @rl/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @rl/desktop
